title: Verify
guide-section: Get Started

## Check the log

Open the AppDaemon add-on in Home Assistant and select **Log**, or run the command the deploy script prints:

```sh
ssh root@homeassistant.local ha addons logs a0d7b954_appdaemon
```

Each app logs one line when it loads, with its light, levels, start triggers and test event. For example:

```
INFO bedroom_sunrise: load: init; light=light.bedroom_lamp detector=sun from_level=-6° to_level=0° off_level=4° brightness=5%..50% start="daily at 05:45:00" test_event=bedroom_sunrise_start
```

After that, the app logs each start trigger, each brightness change and why nothing happened when a start trigger does nothing. A morning looks like:

```
INFO bedroom_sunrise: check: start trigger; daily at 05:45:00
INFO bedroom_sunrise: arm: short of from_level; sun=-9.8° to_level=0° off_level=4°
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: ramp 0%; light.bedroom_lamp 5% sun=-9.8° transition=5s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: ramp 70%; light.bedroom_lamp 31% sun=-3.0° transition=60s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: ramp done: past to_level; sun=1.1° to_level=0°
INFO bedroom_sunrise: off: reached off_level; light.bedroom_lamp sun=4.0° off_level=4° transition=300s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: disarm: reached off_level; until next start trigger
```

Sun updates that change nothing are logged at DEBUG.

A settings mistake shows up here as a validation error naming the bad setting.

## Fire a test event

Each app listens for the event `<app name>_start`. In Home Assistant, go to **Developer Tools > Events**, enter the event type, for example `bedroom_sunrise_start`, and select **Fire event**.

This runs the same check as the app's start trigger. During the fade window the light changes. Outside it the log says why, for example `skip arm: past from_level; sun=12.0° from_level=-6°`, which still confirms the app is running.
